title: Vishnu Puranam - 03 - Kurma Avataram
author: Vishnu Sreenivas
excerpt:
Today we shall see the story of Kurma Avataram and the kshethra maahatmiyam of Srikurmam.

Once there was a dancer who wanted to impress the goddess, Maha Lakshmi. The dancer performed a very intricate set of dances, and soon the goddess appeared before her and presented the dancer with a garland. Shortly after this, it is said that Sage Durvasa was passing by and saw the lovely garland on the neck of the dancer. The dancer offered the sage the garland and left the scene.
